words.sense: Consistent honesty and moral integrity, especially when misconduct could pay.
Behavior in line with social rules of what is considered correct or decent.
misconceptions: Doing an ethical act is just following social etiquette.

semantic_axes.description: Probity concerns moral honesty even without supervision, whereas propriety concerns conduct accepted as socially correct.

edges.boundary_rule: Probity concerns moral honesty even without supervision, whereas propriety concerns conduct accepted as socially correct.

misconceptions.M2: Doing an ethical act is just following social etiquette.
misconceptions.M3: Breaking a custom necessarily means being dishonest.

chains.frame: Which quality is shown by Farah’s handling of the till?

beats.text: Farah found an extra payment and entered it in the accounts instead of keeping the difference.
beats.decisive_clue: recorded money she could have pocketed
beats.reason: Her choice protects honesty when cheating might go unnoticed.

beats.text: She wore her usual uniform while doing the paperwork.
beats.decisive_clue: recorded money she could have pocketed; clothing is irrelevant
beats.reason: Her uniform says nothing about the integrity of the decision.

chains.feedback_short: Recording an unnoticed extra payment shows integrity; the uniform does not decide it.
chains.feedback_deep: Probity concerns a sound ethical choice, especially when an improper gain is possible. Propriety would concern correct conduct or decorum, not the key financial decision.
chains.contrast_rule: Probity is about doing right; propriety is about behaving appropriately.

hints.attention: Ask what she could have gained by staying silent.
hints.axis: Probity concerns moral honesty even without supervision, whereas propriety concerns conduct accepted as socially correct.
hints.contrast: Probity is about doing right; propriety is about behaving appropriately.

chains.frame: Which quality best describes Dev’s behavior during the visit?

beats.text: Dev thanked the host, waited until she finished speaking, and handed her an envelope with both hands.
beats.decisive_clue: used considerate manners while handing over an envelope
beats.reason: His courtesy follows the gathering’s expectations.

beats.text: He also pointed out that the envelope held more money than he owed her and returned the extra notes.
beats.decisive_clue: returned the extra cash as part of the same handover
beats.reason: The envelope handover also reveals honesty about an unearned advantage.

chains.feedback_short: Dev’s handover shows courtesy at first, then integrity when he returns an excess payment.
chains.feedback_deep: Propriety describes the courteous way Dev hands over the envelope. Probity becomes the better choice when its contents reveal his decision to return money he could have kept.
chains.contrast_rule: Probity is about doing right; propriety is about behaving appropriately.

hints.attention: Consider the new choice involving the extra money.
hints.axis: Probity concerns moral honesty even without supervision, whereas propriety concerns conduct accepted as socially correct.
hints.contrast: Probity is about doing right; propriety is about behaving appropriately.

chains.frame: Which quality does Salma display at the dinner?

beats.text: Salma silenced her phone, listened during speeches, and waited her turn to speak.
beats.reason: This is respectful conduct suited to the occasion.

beats.text: Even after an embarrassing joke, she waited until the speech ended before responding.
beats.reason: Restraint during an awkward moment reinforces social correctness.

chains.feedback_short: Waiting through an awkward joke shows attention to the occasion’s conventions.
chains.feedback_deep: Propriety means following accepted standards of appropriate behavior. No test of hidden honesty or temptation appears, so probity is not the defining quality.
chains.contrast_rule: Probity is about doing right; propriety is about behaving appropriately.

hints.attention: Look at how she handles the event’s expectations.
hints.axis: Probity concerns moral honesty even without supervision, whereas propriety concerns conduct accepted as socially correct.
hints.contrast: Probity is about doing right; propriety is about behaving appropriately.

chains.frame: Which quality is shown by Omar’s recommendation for a friend?

beats.text: Omar refused to confirm volunteer hours that his friend had claimed but never completed.
beats.decisive_clue: would not certify hours he knew were false
beats.reason: He acts honestly despite pressure to help a friend.

beats.text: He sent the signed recommendation a day later than the usual deadline.
beats.decisive_clue: refused to endorse false hours despite a late submission
beats.reason: Missing the deadline does not erase the honest choice.

chains.feedback_short: Omar would not certify false hours; missing the deadline is a separate procedural matter.
chains.feedback_deep: Probity refers to consistent ethical integrity. Omar will not verify hours he knows are untrue, even for a friend. The deadline is a separate issue of procedure.
chains.contrast_rule: Probity is about doing right; propriety is about behaving appropriately.

hints.axis: Probity concerns moral honesty even without supervision, whereas propriety concerns conduct accepted as socially correct.
hints.contrast: Probity is about doing right; propriety is about behaving appropriately.

chains.frame: Which quality does Yuki demonstrate at the ceremony?

beats.text: Yuki followed the seating instructions and kept her voice low during the vows.
beats.reason: The conduct is socially appropriate for a formal occasion.

beats.text: Yuki followed those same customs even though the ceremony was held outdoors.
beats.decisive_clue: respected expected behavior despite the different venue
beats.reason: The setting does not introduce an honesty test.

chains.feedback_short: Her attention to ceremony etiquette matters; the venue does not.
chains.feedback_deep: Propriety is about socially accepted standards. Changing from an indoor to an outdoor ceremony does not convert respectful manners into proof of moral integrity.
chains.contrast_rule: Probity is about doing right; propriety is about behaving appropriately.

hints.attention: Focus on the conduct rather than the location.
hints.axis: Probity concerns moral honesty even without supervision, whereas propriety concerns conduct accepted as socially correct.
hints.contrast: Probity is about doing right; propriety is about behaving appropriately.
